#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

int main() {
    int n, b;
    std::cin >> n >> b;
    std::vector<int> arr(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> arr[i];
    }

    int even = 0, odd = 0;
    int j = 0;
    std::vector<int> cut;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (arr[i] % 2 == 0)
            ++even;
        else
            ++odd;

        if (even == odd && i != n - 1) {
            cut.push_back(i + 1);
            even = 0;
            odd = 0;
            ++j;
        }
    }

    int count = 0;
    if (j > 1) {
        std::vector<int> bitcoin(j);
        for (int i = 0; i < j; ++i) {
            int diff = arr[cut[i]] - arr[cut[i] - 1];
            bitcoin[i] = std::abs(diff);
        }
        std::sort(bitcoin.begin(), bitcoin.end());
        if (bitcoin[0] > b) {
            count = 0;
        } else {
            for (int i = 1; i < j; ++i) {
                bitcoin[i] += bitcoin[i - 1];
                if (bitcoin[i] > b) {
                    count = i;
                    break;
                } else {
                    count = i + 1;
                }
            }
        }
    } else {
        if (j == 0) {
            count = 0;
        } else {
            int a = arr[cut[0]] - arr[cut[0] - 1];
            a = std::abs(a);
            if (j == 1 && a >= b)
                count = 1;
        }
    }

    std::cout << count << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
